title: Concept: Pseudo-random generator constructed with a constant seed in csharp — review required
description: In csharp, Random is constructed with an explicit seed. The sequence is fully determined by the seed and the algorithm, so two deployments with the same seed mint the same values. Security values need an interface backed by the operating system entropy source.
applicability: csharp services that mint identifiers or tokens.
risk: Reproducible tokens and identifiers; MEDIUM severity.
